summary: Kenneth Ward, 79, of Florence, drowned after his solo private raft capsized on the Arkansas River in the Florence area; witnesses saw him in distress floating by Florence River Park; Colorado Parks and Wildlife launched a search around 4 p.m., suspended Monday evening and resumed the next morning, with his body recovered after 3:30 p.m. on June 7; flush drowning.
location: Florence River Park, Florence, Arkansas River
notes: Source: American Whitewater accident record (wp-json 68686) quoting the Pueblo Chieftain; parent-verified. Fremont County Coroner Randy Keller. Inserted run 1014 (Chieftain chunk).
